subject: Evaluator access & non-prod evidence packaging for FedRAMP/ISO sampling
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finovatebank.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluator access and non-prod evidence packaging for FedRAMP/ISO sampling

Hi team—

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our audit cadence we need to schedule the sampling window for the FedRAMP readiness review and align on what your evaluator will need to access. A few initial asks from our side: 

- Can you package a non-prod evidence bundle (application logs, config snapshots, and a list of ephemeral credentials) for the sampling window (targeting 2027-05-10 to 2027-05-14)?
- Will you provide a time-limited read-only account for the external evaluator, or do you prefer we use shared snapshots (we prefer time-limited accounts if possible).
- We need an agreed plan for redaction of secrets and KMS/HSM references inside artifacts.

If you can confirm approach and ownership by EOD Monday (05/03), we can lock the evaluator schedule. Attaching our intake template for SIG/CAIQ mapping (see attachment).

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Senior InfoSec Manager, Finovate Bank
[Attachment: sig_caiq-intake-template.docx (docx, 120KB)]

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finovatebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluator access and non-prod evidence packaging for FedRAMP/ISO sampling

Alice—

Appreciate the checklist. Quick summary of our proposal so we have it in writing: 

1) Evidence packaging approach
   - We'll produce a staged evidence bundle containing: sampled application logs (rotated and compressed), config snapshots (service manifests and infra-as-code templates), and control narratives mapped to SIG/CAIQ questions.
   - Sensitive fields (KMS key ARNs, HSM identifiers, raw secrets) will be redacted and replaced with deterministic placeholders; we will include a mapping doc for internal reviewers only.

2) Evaluator access model
   - Primary method: provide a time-limited, read-only evaluator account scoped to a non-production tenant with strict network egress controls. SSH/RDP access will be disabled; file-level access will be via a temporary Audit S3 bucket with one-time pre-signed links.
   - Fallback: snapshot bundle if procurement or netsec restricts external credential issuance.

3) Schedule & owners
   - Evidence bundle prep: owners = Compliance (Marissa) + Platform Ops (Sergio). Target drop: 2027-05-07.
   - Evaluator account provisioning: owner = Security Ops (Kimberly). Target ready-by: 2027-05-09.

I attached a first-pass SIG/CAIQ response workbook and a sample non-prod log archive (redacted). Please confirm if this model works for Finovate and whether the evaluator needs live console access or strictly artifact review.

[Attachment: sig_caiq-responses-v0.9.xlsx (xlsx, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: nonprod-log-sample-202703.tgz (tgz, 5.6MB)]

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, Alice Chen <alice.chen@finovatebank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluator access and non-prod evidence packaging for FedRAMP/ISO sampling

Thanks for the plan, Sergio. A couple procurement/security constraints to flag so expectations are aligned: 

- Our procurement team requires a scoped external access agreement (simple addendum) for any third party evaluator accounts. I can fast-track the document but we need the evaluator's org/legal name and a point of contact for PO/contracting.
- Network team will enforce egress rules; the temporary Audit S3 bucket is fine but we need an artifact access log exported daily to a retention sandbox. That export will be included in the evidence bundle.
- No live console sessions for external evaluators unless we run them via a monitored jump-host session (recorded). If Finovate requires a console walkthrough, we'll schedule a recorded session during the sampling window.

I created a procurement ticket and linked it here: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/COMPL-482. Please provide the evaluator contact and PO/contract lead so I can attach the addendum.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finovatebank.com>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluator access and non-prod evidence packaging for FedRAMP/ISO sampling

Hi Alice—

Agree with Sergio and Kimberly. A few practical notes from Compliance on the sample composition so the auditor's sampling is defensible: 

- Log sampling: we'll include three independent 24-hour windows from March/April that represent peak, quiet, and deployment-day traffic. Logs will be indexed and checksummed; we'll include a CSV that maps timestamps to the relevant control IDs.
- Config snapshots: we'll include IaC plan outputs (Terraform plan), runtime service manifests, and a digest of container images (no image layers).
- Non-prod: confirm that Finovate is comfortable with the evaluator landing in our non-prod tenant; otherwise we'll provide the same artifacts via the bundle + recorded console walkthrough.

Attachment: evaluator-ssh-access-instructions.txt — this is a short checklist we will follow for issuing time-limited access (2FA, IP allowlist, TTL 72h).

If we don't have a hard objection from Finovate by EOD, we'll proceed with the drop on 05/07 and provision the evaluator account for 05/09.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evaluator-ssh-access-instructions.txt (txt, 3KB)]

From: Audit Ops <auditops@auditlane.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@finovatebank.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluator access and non-prod evidence packaging for FedRAMP/ISO sampling

Thanks all — AuditLane confirms the evaluation team and schedule: 

- Evaluator org: AuditLane, LLC (EIN: 12-3456789). Primary contact: samir.patel@auditlane.com (Samir Patel).
- We can operate with the artifact bundle alone, but prefer the time-limited read-only account for sample verification. Our standard is TTL 48–72h, IP-restricted, and MFA-enforced.
- We will sign the access addendum; Samir will provide PO/contact details for procurement.

Action items we need from Redwood by 05/05 (COB): 
- Final SIG/CAIQ workbook (updated responses).
- Evidence bundle delivery link and checksum manifest.
- Evaluator contact details for procurement addendum.

We can do a recorded console walkthrough on 05/11 if required. Looking forward to the artifacts.

—AuditLane (Samir on behalf of evaluation team)
